verdict.rationale: AWS Budgets is documented for tracking costs and usage. It supports a fixed monthly budget with alerts on both actual and forecasted spend, and budget actions can apply an IAM policy that blocks new provisioning. The Free plan promises no charges or surprise bills until you convert to Paid. However, the pack never documents spend anomaly detection, a named element of the story, and community reports describe how hard it is to trace small unexpected charges. Missing for 10: documented cost anomaly detection, evidence that budgets and alerts are on by default or easy to set up on day one, independent hands-on corroboration that budget alerts prevent bill surprises.
